notes: of* God* is folded onto χρηματισθέντες under rule 103, the lexeme meaning to be divinely instructed and no other token licensing the words; ACT.10.22 is the precedent and MAT.2.22 reads the same lemma the same way (rule 24).
διά is unrepresented: the ASV writes another way with no preposition anywhere, which is the only case rule 36 allows.
